programme.title: Peyrol le boucanier
programme.desc: Un ancien pirate contre-révolutionnaire se lie d'amitié avec une jeune femme atteinte de troubles mentaux, ce qui conduit à une tragédie lorsqu'elle tombe amoureuse d'un officier de la marine française.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque un gang vicieux de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière jusqu'au Mexique.

programme.title: Erik le viking
programme.desc: À la mort de leur chef, Erik et Eyolf sont désignés pour diriger le peuple viking. Eyolf voit d'un mauvais œil ce partage du pouvoir auquel il ne s'attendait pas.

programme.title: Le justicier de Dieu
programme.desc: Un ancien tireur devenu prêtre cherche à se venger de trois bandits qui se font passer pour des citoyens respectueux de la loi.

programme.title: Le pistolero de Tombstone
programme.desc: Un jeune déserteur de l'armée retourne sur les lieux où son père a été tué par une famille de propriétaires terriens mexicains. La tâche n'est pas facile car il est seul à vouloir venger la mort de son père.

programme.title: Nazis au centre de la terre
programme.desc: Des chercheurs en Antarctique sont enlevés et traînés sous terre par une équipe de survivants nazis qui planifient la renaissance du Troisième Reich.

programme.title: Xtro 3
programme.desc: Des marines se rendent sur une île déserte pour désamorcer des bombes, mais ils sont terrorisés par une créature extraterrestre mortelle.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: Terreur sur la lagune
programme.desc: Le corps d'une écolière est retrouvé dans une prairie. Le meurtrier n'est jamais arrêté et, des années plus tard, un jeune homme nommé Stefano retourne sur l'île et retrouve son frère, le prêtre local.

programme.title: Phantom
programme.desc: Jake est assassiné par des voyous de quartier. Il revient sous une forme surnaturelle (Le Spectre) pour se venger.

programme.title: Le Tourbillon De Couleurs
programme.desc: Après plusieurs années à se cacher, une jeune femme est contrainte à la cavale une fois que ses super pouvoirs sont révélés au grand jour. Des années après avoir abandonné sa famille, elle n'a pas d'autre choix que de rentrer à la maison.

programme.title: Curvature
programme.desc: Après le suicide de son mari Wells, Helen découvre que son passé cachait bien des secrets. Lors d'une étrange panne de courant, elle se réveille chez elle et reçoit un appel d'elle-même l'avertissant qu'un homme vient pour la tuer.

programme.title: Level 16

programme.desc: Après un terrible accident, une femme suit une rééducation utilisant une technologie d'intelligence artificielle pour faciliter son processus de guérison, explorant ainsi l'intersection entre les perspectives humaines et mécaniques.

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: De retour à Delta City, Robocop affronte un scientifique fou décidé à contrôler la ville grâce à un ordinateur au cerveau humain.

programme.title: Final days
programme.desc: Aidan se barricade chez lui face à l'invasion zombie et découvre une jeune femme piégée dans sa cour. Ensemble, ils cherchent une issue.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre: Fusion
programme.desc: Maiya traverse des phases dimensionnelles, Augur et Liam veulent fusionner les univers, et Jonathan Doors lance sa candidature.

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Accusé du meurtre d'un télévangéliste, Robocop devient fugitif et mène sa propre enquête pour retrouver le vrai coupable.

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Un gang plonge Delta City dans le noir et tend un piège à Robocop, qui doit stopper une menace terroriste.

programme.title: Freaks of Nature
programme.desc: À Dillford, humains, vampires et zombies doivent s'unir quand des aliens débarquent.

programme.title: David & Goliath
programme.desc: Un berger nommé David se transforme en un puissant guerrier pour affronter Goliath.

programme.title: Thor : God of Thunder
programme.desc: Loki, s'est échappé d'Asgard pour rechercher Yggdrasil - L'Arbre des Neuf Royaumes.

programme.title: L'Epée de l'Empereur
programme.desc: Une épée de pouvoir divisée déclenche un massacre, et la fille d'un grand général devient le dernier rempart contre un tyran.

programme.title: Yamada, La Voie du Samourai
programme.desc: Yamada Nagamasa est laissé pour mort par les forces japonaises. Il se rétablit dans un village ou il apprend l'art du Muay Boran.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: Un immense vaisseau accueille une compétition de sport spatial appelé Cosmoball.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: Une équipe d'opérations secrètes est envoyée pour enquêter sur le crash d'un objet non identifié.

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Une nouvelle race de requins particulièrement agressifs sort de son sommeil après le dégel d'une partie profonde de l'océan.

programme.title: Mutant Legacy
programme.desc: Un groupe de mutants parias est traqué par un organisme gouvernemental.

programme.title: Methgator
programme.desc: La police avait prévenu les habitants de ne pas jeter de la méthamphétamine dans les toilettes afin d'éviter que les alligators en mangent. À Sweet Water Point, en Floride, ils n'ont pas écouté.

programme.title: Jurassic Planet
programme.desc: Un vaisseau spatial s'écrase sur une planète inconnue peuplée de dinosaures.

programme.title: La vie des autres
programme.desc: À Berlin-Est en 1984, un agent espionne un couple et se laisse peu à peu changer profondément.

programme.title: Bolshoi, le grand saut
programme.desc: Une jeune danseuse est remarquée par un ancien danseur qui lui prédit un avenir de grande ballerine.

programme.title: The Club
programme.desc: Enquête sur des prêtres reclus au Chili suspectés de graves crimes par l'Église.

programme.title: Comet
programme.desc: Dell et Kimberly vivent six ans d'amour tumultueux, de Paris à New York, jusqu'à Hollywood.

programme.title: Itinéraire manqué
programme.desc: Deon Barnes (50 Cent), une star du football universitaire, rêve d'une carrière en NFL tandis que sa famille place tous ses espoirs dans son succès. Après une victoire cruciale, Deon s'effondre et reçoit un diagnostic de cancer, brisant ses rêves.

programme.title: Pour toujours et a jamais
programme.desc: Après qu'une tragédie réunit Nicole avec ses amis d'enfance, ils se retrouvent chacun en danger, ciblés par un harceleur fou. Nicole sait que ça ne peut pas être une coïncidence. Les secrets de leur passé reviennent les hanter.

programme.title: Les évadés de Santiago
programme.desc: Le récit haletant de l'une des plus grandes évasions carcérales de l'Histoire, celle de 49 prisonniers politiques chiliens au crépuscule de la dictature d'Augusto Pinochet.

programme.title: Sweet Land
programme.desc: Quand Inge, la grand-mère de Lars, meurt en 2004, il doit prendre une décision. Vendre la ferme familiale où elle a vécu depuis 1920 ou conserver l'héritage de la terre. Il se tourne vers la mémoire d'Inge et les histoires qu'elle lui a racontées.

programme.title: Red Screening
programme.desc: Un vieux cinéma, un refuge pluvieux... et un tueur en cavale traquant ses proies.

programme.title: Le triangle de l'apocalypse
programme.desc: En mer du Nord, le stockage de CO2 est une activité lucrative qui cache un péril mortel.

programme.desc: Une juge teste une IA, découvre un meurtre et affronte de puissants intérêts étatiques.

programme.title: Le suspect idéal
programme.desc: Meurtre atroce : lors d'un interrogatoire, un génie instable retourne la situation face aux flics.

programme.title: Au bout du tunnel
programme.desc: Un ingénieur paraplégique entend des bruits et les voix de braqueurs de banques dans son sous-sol.

programme.title: Bad Man
programme.desc: À Colt Lake, le shérif Sam Evans enquête sur un trafic de méthamphétamine. L'arrivée de Bobby Gaines, agent infiltré aussi charismatique qu'imprévisible, bouleverse l'affaire. Mais derrière son image de héros se cachent des secrets prêts à tout faire exploser.

programme.title: The Adventurers
programme.desc: Les plus grands voleurs du monde unissent leurs forces pour réaliser le casse de leur vie. Mais lorsqu'ils sont poursuivis à travers toute l'Europe par un détective français de légende, ils vont devoir passer à la vitesse supérieure.

programme.title: Runaway
programme.desc: Quand la famille de Luna est tuée de sang-froid lors de vacances à la montagne. Luna a la possibilité de fuir le pays. Mais d'abord, elle veut se venger.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary, une dangereuse tueuse à gages, travaille pour la famille du crime la plus célèbre de la ville, dirigée par Benny. Lorsque Mary tue un mafieux sous protection pour sauver un jeune garçon, elle doit faire face à de nombreux criminels de renom, y compris son ancien amant.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: Après la mort de son frère, un combattant part en Thaïlande pour affronter son meurtrier et survivre à un duel brutal.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: Kidnappé après une victoire, Kurt Sloane est enfermé à Bangkok et forcé d'affronter un géant pour gagner sa liberté.

programme.title: Red Rock West
programme.desc: À Red Rock, Michael est pris pour un tueur à gages. Entre mensonges, argent et vrai assassin, la situation devient incontrôlable.

programme.title: Affinity
programme.desc: Bruno, ex-SEAL traumatisé, reprend les armes lorsqu'une femme mystérieuse qui lui avait redonné espoir est enlevée.

programme.title: Night Shot
programme.desc: Une jeune blogueuse spécialisée dans l'exploration urbaine (urbex) décide d'aller visiter un gigantesque hôpital abandonné. Comme toujours elle part seule et de nuit avec son cameraman, afin de faire vivre en direct ses aventures à ses followers, avec une particularité : ne jamais couper la caméra...

programme.title: Hitcher
programme.desc: Jim Halsey accepte de convoyer une voiture à travers les États-Unis pour s'éviter des frais de voyage onéreux. Par une nuit pluvieuse il prend en auto-stop un dénommé John Ryder, un personnage étrange et inquiétant. Jim comprend très rapidement qu'il a affaire à un tueur psychopathe...

programme.title: Good Boy
programme.desc: Un chien fidèle accompagne son maître dans une maison de campagne isolée. Mais bientôt, il perçoit des forces surnaturelles tapies dans l'ombre. Alors que ces entités malveillantes menacent son compagnon humain, le courageux animal doit livrer un combat acharné pour protéger celui qu'il aime plus que tout.

programme.title: Your Monster
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Sharknado 6
programme.desc: Après avoir perdu tout ce qui lui était cher, Fin se retrouve à errer seul sur Terre. Mais il va découvrir qu'en utilisant la tempête de requins comme portail, il peut voyager dans le temps.

programme.title: President Down
programme.desc: Un message secret annonce que le pacemaker de la Présidente a été compromis.

programme.title: Intro Shark Warning
programme.desc: Intro Shark Warning

programme.title: Shark Warning
programme.desc: Vingt ans après, un homme revient dans la ville où son frère a été tué par un requin. Bientôt le prédateur refait surface et tue à nouveau, l'homme décide de le traquer pour l'arrêter une fois pour toutes.

programme.title: Boston Streets
programme.desc: Deux amis d'enfance du sud de Boston se tournent vers le crime pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Into the Deep
programme.desc: Cassidy, biologiste marine, part plonger près de Madagascar. Capturée par des pirates, elle est forcée de plonger dans des eaux pleines de requins pour récupérer de la drogue engloutie.

programme.title: The Punisher
programme.desc: Ancien membre de la Delta Force, puis agent spécial au FBI, Frank Castle s'apprête à se retirer pour mener une existence paisible auprès de sa femme et de son jeune fils. Lors de son ultime mission, les choses tournent mal et le fils de Howard Saint, puissant businessman et magnat de la pègre, est tué. Ivre de vengeance, Saint organise le massacre de Frank et de toute sa famille.

programme.title: Las Vegas 21
programme.desc: Inspiré de l'histoire vraie d'un groupe d'étudiants du M.I.T. qui, passés maîtres de l'art de prévoir les cartes, ont gagné des millions de dollars dans les casinos de Las Vegas. Ben Campbell (Jim Sturgess) a du mal à payer ses études et se laisse embarquer par les élites du M.I.T. dans une entreprise audacieuse : faire fortune à Las Vegas. Avec l'aide d'un éminent professeur de statistiques (Kevin Spacey), armés de faux papiers et d'un système compliqué de comptage des cartes, Ben et ses amis réussissent à pénétrer au cœur des casinos et à remporter des sommes folles. Le plus dur sera bientôt de ne pas perdre le contrôle de la situation...

programme.title: Xxx Triple X
programme.desc: Après une série de tests, Xander 'XXX' Cage, un spécialiste des sports extrêmes couvert de tatouages, est recruté par Augustus Gibbons, un agent de la NSA, pour s'infiltrer dans une organisation criminelle et mettre fin à ses agissements. programme.title: Poppy Jamie: There's No Such Thing As Coincidence
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Poppy Jamie discusses intuition, coincidence, and inner wisdom with Fearne Cotton. They explore why collective exhaustion stems from trusting logic over gut instinct, and how inexplicable moments expand our understanding of what's possible. Poppy shares her near-infertility diagnosis and how belief in magic, intuition, and the support of wise women have helped her cope.

programme.title: Perrie Edwards On The Cost Of Fame
programme.desc: A panic attack can feel like you're dying from a heart attack this is something former Little Mix member Perrie Edwards has experienced numerous times over the last few years. Perrie talks about how her anxiety feels like her adult is 'going offline', leaving the child in her crying for help.

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right
programme.desc: Stephen Kapos is an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor who discusses his activism, his opposition to Israel's systemic destruction of Gaza and the West Bank, and how the memory of the Holocaust is being abused by Israel and the far-right.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran's Palestine Downfall
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran dropped Macklemore from his tour over the artist's pro-Palestine platform. He played his last gig alone, after all of his supporting artists and his backing band dropped out in solidarity. Ava and Seán break down what happened and react to Sheeran's apology.

programme.title: Did A GB News Host Write A Book Full Of AI Slop?

Shirley absolutely loves her hobby but may have gone a little overboard in her planning: she plans to put herself and her brides in noisy shimmy belts, has peacock feather centerpieces, and to top it all off, she's had a fake foam cake made to save money! programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: Mountains define some of our most spectacular landscapes, creating a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. Mountains are found on every continent on Earth, covering 22% of the planet's surface. They're a vital part of our ecosystem a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds. It's no wonder that so many cultures consider mountains sacred places: gateways to the heavens.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Stewart Island, New Zealand's third largest and southernmost island, is a place of dramatic beauty and unpredictability. Here, the Pot-bellied Seahorse father has extra responsibilities, the Octopus is both hunter and hunted, and 82 Great White Sharks need to eat, too. Standing at just 30cm and weighing only 1 kg, the Little Blue Penguin is nonetheless a swift swimmer and a determined parent.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.title: Heroes Of The Wild Frontiers

programme.title: Wild Gangs
programme.desc: Life can be tough at times, but it gets much easier when you have friends to watch your back. Animals from across the natural world band together for all sorts of reasons. Whether it's to protect the home and family, to find food, win a mate or even go to war, it's always handy to have someone you can trust in your corner. From the classic pack of wolves stalking prey in tandem to the bullish lionfish mobs terrorising all other fish on the reef – when animals form gangs things soon get wild!

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: In the earth's polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland's Saami people, Alaska's Inuit, Canada's Native Americans and New Zealand's Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Who is the best cook in all the forest? Masha has no doubts as to how to correctly answer this question. And the proof is right before you: macaroni cooked by Masha herself. What can be simpler? Only Dasha is somehow sure that Masha's final product is inedible. As usual, Bear will have to solve the girls' dispute, as usual.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha enthusiastically plays with her "dolls", but Rosie wants to be independent. She trades places with wolves and now they are under Masha's care. Rosie enjoys adult life, but everything is not that simple ...

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

All forest dwellers are very excited to get chocolate eggs except for the wolves who long for some real food… Masha decides to help poor guys and arranges a splendid dinner!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Bright summer day. Bear, while gathering berries, meets female bear in the forest and arranges a date with her. Returning home, he starts cleaning the house and baking a pie. Once the pie is done, the Bear decorates it with strawberries. Masha eats them before starting to hiccup. The Bear tries all manner of remedies from a medical encyclo-pedia to stop the hiccups. In the end, hiccups spread to everyone including all other forest in-habitants.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan meets Gayatri and apologizes to her. He tells Gayatri that she forgave him every time and now it is his turn to return the favor. This leaves Indravadhan and Gayatri stranded in the center of a ring of fire. Will Indravadhan learn that Avdesh has a trick up his sleeve? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Avdesh decide to play a game of chess. At first, Indravadhan claims that he would not gamble. He is then convinced by Avdesh, who claims that this game would not involve any kind of gambling. The game begins and the two contenders start betting one different things. Avdesh wins the first move and asks Raj Mata to prepare food for him for a week. Indravadhan wins the next move and asks Avdesh's horse as reward. What will Avdesh bet on? Is he playing a mind game with Indravadhan? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

Economists and agencies like ICRA and CRISIL are anticipating the hike, which could make home loans, car loans, floating rates, and EMIs more expensive.

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: A reported list of 209 BJP candidates for the 2027 UP Assembly elections has triggered speculation and confusion within the party, with questions over whether Yogi Adityanath sent it to the high command and reports of Amit Shah's displeasure, an internal inquiry, and a joint clarification by Yogi Adityanath and state BJP president Pankaj Chaudhary.

programme.title: Sehat

programme.title: UP Bulletin

programme.title: The Cinema Show

The show also covers its potential releases in China, Russia, Japan, and South Korea.

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge

programme.title: Asaan Bhasa Main

programme.title: Tarikh

programme.title: Sciencekari

programme.title: Neta Nagari

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.10

When Se Gi arrives at the company, all eyes turn to him, and he even confronts Gi Joon directly. Meanwhile, Hwa Ran meets Ri Jin and tells her to report everything Do Hyun does.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.11

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.12
programme.desc: Do Hyun despairs after realizing the things Se Gi has done. Chae Yeon grows even more conflicted over Do Hyun's sudden change in attitude. Ri Jin, like Se Gi once did, struggles to help Do Hyun change for the better, while Tae Im meets Seok Ho Pil.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.13
programme.desc: Ri Jin begins having nightmares, worrying Do Hyun. However, she keeps her distance, prompting Do Hyun to reconsider her relationship with Ri On. Meanwhile, Young Pyo becomes convinced that Min Seo Yeon's child is still alive, and Ri On has his first encounter with Yo Na, one of Do Hyun's personalities.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.14
programme.desc: Do Hyun regains his laughter while spending time with Ri Jin's family. Soon Young encourages him to pursue Ri Jin and shows him photos of Ri Jin and Ri On as children. Meanwhile, Do Hyun's repressed memories of the basement resurface, and he meets the personality “Nana.” Chae Yeon calls off her engagement with Gi Joon.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of the Christmas Special the Year-End Special and the New-Year Special and the guest of the Year-End Special Episode is Kwon Jin ah. Kwon Jin ah is known for her tranquil and heartwarming voice that genuinely comforts our hearts. In February this year she released her first self-produced EP “The Way For Us” and showed off her capabilities as a songwriter and producer as well. In this episode Kwon Jin ah performs “KNOCK” “This Winter” and her solo version of “Hello Antenna Hello Christmas” the carol jointly released by musicians on the record label Antenna. Also famous for her live singing skills and ticket-selling power this artist is bound to melt our souls during this cold winter season. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of the Christmas Special the Year-End Special and the New-Year Special and the guest of the New-Year Special Episode is Juk Jae. Juk Jae is a guitarist-turned-singer-songwriter known for his lyrical and ambient songs with a guitar sound. Since his debut in 2014 he has collaborated with numerous singers including IU and Zion T and has also released many hit songs but he is still determined to show his transformation and growth through music. As part of that effort he hosts the audio show “Juk Jae's Night Time Studio” and also went on his first concert tour across Korea in November last year. In this New-Year Special Edition Juk Jae performs “Let's Go See The Stars” “Sky Dream” “One Another” and more to amaze our ears and souls. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Younha! Younha began her career in 2003 in Japan with her first single “ゆびきり.” Then she found mainstream success the following year with her second Japanese single “ほうき星 (Comet)” which was included on the soundtrack of the anime series “Bleach.” The song peaked on the Oricon Chart at #15 giving her the nickname of the “Oricon Comet.” Her success in the island country led to her debut in Korea as well she debuted in Korea in 2016 where she is regarded as one of the country's best singer-songwriters. From “Waiting” to “Password 486” Younha has many hit songs under her belt. She has also collaborated with numerous A-list musicians including Toy and Epik High. In November last year Younha released her sixth full-length album “END THEORY” to once again prove how versatile of a musician she is. From rock to ballad music she covered various genres in the album and the album's lead single “Stardust” was chosen as one of Billboard's Best K-pop Songs of the Year. In this episode Younha performs “Stardust” “Wish” “Waiting” “How U doing” and more to nourish our hearts. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: Following the September 11 attacks, military presence became commonplace in New York and other American cities, and the counter terrorism forces were effectively given a “blank cheque” when it came to ensuring that another terrorist incident would never take place on American soil. This episode of CQB takes an in–depth look at who was selected to occupy elite anti-terrorist positions, what they were trained for, and how they were equipped: when opposing forces are using commercial airliners and chemical weapons, countermeasures are by necessity complicated and varied. CQB takes an intimate look at what it was like to be an officer on alert for chemical attacks in Washington DC, or an army reservist monitoring suspicious activities on the streets of NYC.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: No country other than France operates an elite military force that invites foreign nationals to serve in its ranks. With a reputation for being a safe haven for individuals with questionable pasts, the French Foreign Legion is a true mercenary army that has garnered significant respect within the global special operations community. This episode of CQB examines a raid by the Foreign Legion on a small airport in Iraq during the 1990 Gulf War, exploring the nature of the Legion, how it differs from other special forces, and how it prepares for a wide variety of close quarter battle scenarios in conflict situations around the world.
